records.excerpt: Officer Walden is found in the Giordano Botanical Gardens, just outside of Poison Ivy's greenhouse, and starts the Freelance mission Brother Blue in Trouble, but only after the completion of Weeds of Oblivion.
records.location: Giordano Botanical Gardens, outside Poison Ivy's greenhouse
records.precision: Mission contact position and prerequisite documented by the Officer Walden source entry

records.excerpt: The Fearmonger is found in the Metropolis City Hall in the Historic District, and must be talked to by villains to start Fish in a Barrel.
records.precision: Mission contact position documented by the Fearmonger NPC source entry

records.excerpt: Doctor Sarah Charles can be found in the Little Bohemia MPD near the Booster Gold Kiosk
records.location: Little Bohemia Police Station, near the Booster Gold Kiosk
records.precision: The mission names Doctor Sarah Charles in the Little Bohemia Police Station; her NPC source entry identifies the nearby kiosk

records.excerpt: Space/Off is one of the possible missions for heroes and villains from the Daily: Master of Disguise set of missions. Its objectives include: Return to Jimmy Olsen in Death Metal Washington, D.C.
records.location: Jimmy Olsen: Death Metal Washington, D.C.
records.precision: The parent mission names Jimmy Olsen as its contact; its explicitly listed Space/Off child mission places him in Death Metal Washington, D.C. This establishes mission-set area context, not an exact contact spawn point.
